candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the literal product of carrier, electronic, vibration, rotation, spin, composition, observation and record forms; decide all 256 only from admitted composition, transition, selection and exact spectroscopy dependencies.

excluded_inputs: no numerical zero; external zero is structural EmptyOne
no negative, irrational, imaginary, floating, signed or continuum proof value
no imported wavefunction, Hamiltonian, rigid rotor, harmonic oscillator, differential equation or fitted spectroscopic constant
no NIST state, multiplicity, constant, transition or band outcome before prediction seal
no singlet-only, triplet-only, common-state-only or resolved-value-only subset
statement: A resolved molecular spectral state is one finite joint product retaining its isotopologue carrier, electronic designation, positive whole spin multiplicity, exact positive vibrational and rotational coordinates or structural EmptyOne, transition/band record and complete source record. No coordinate may be erased, recombined independently or replaced by a continuum premise.
